subject: Intro: VP/CTO alignment + technical deep dive - proposed times

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + VP/CTO intro (next steps)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap from our side:
- Key drivers: reduce per-request inference cost, improve 95th pct latency for batch jobs, and tighten data residency for audit teams.
- Current stack: in-house model hosting on cloud GPUs, looking to reduce ops overhead and improve tail latency for synchronous endpoints.
- Success metric: hold latency under 200ms for conversational flows and reduce per-token cost by ~30% at current volume.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Executive alignment (VP / CTO) to confirm scope and procurement timeline
2) Technical deep dive with SE to scope integration and sizing
3) Draft mutual action plan and procurement checklist

Can we schedule a 30-minute intro between your CTO and our VP of Sales (Vivek) next week to unblock the procurement timeline? Suggested windows (Pacific):
- Tue 4/13, 10:00-10:30am or 3:00-3:30pm
- Wed 4/14, 9:00-9:30am or 11:30-12:00pm

If none of those work, share a couple times that do and Rachel will follow up to lock in the technical deep dive.

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a suggested agenda for the VP/CTO call, feel free to edit.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0102
